title: Check: Pollination and Fertilisation in Plants (Part 2) (C)

questions.stem: Why is cross-pollination generally considered more beneficial than self-pollination?

options.text: It increases genetic variation in offspring
It does not require insects or wind

questions.explanation: Cross-pollination involves pollen from a different plant, which increases genetic variation in the offspring. This gives the species a better chance of adapting to environmental changes.
